newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 91-day bills average accepted yield 4.56 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 91-day bills average accepted yield 4.56 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 91-day bills was 4.56 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Tuesday.
This compared with three-month HIBOR of 5.48958 percent and the average accepted yield of 4.60 percent at last week's tender of the quarterly bills.
Bids for the HK$2 billion issue totalled HK$6.43 billion, down from HK$7.68 billion at the previous tender, the HKMA said.
The authority also tendered HK$5 billion in 28-day bills.
The average accepted yield of the bills was 4.50 percent against one-month HIBOR of 5.34375 percent. Bids totalled HK$12.80 billion
This compared with an average accepted yield of 4.53 percent and bids of HK$3.25 billion for the HK$5 billion one-month issue tendered on January 21.
